faqs.question: Which Alachua County school calendar is available here?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 district 10-month student calendar is available, with the official ACPS PDF, holiday dates and emergency Flex Day notes. Open the school-year page for its complete event list.

faqs.question: Are Alachua County calendars for 2027-2028 through 2029-2030 available here?
faqs.answer: Those school years have not been verified or added to this directory. Check ACPS’s Events page for newly released calendars. Dates from 2026-2027 should not be carried forward into a later year.

faqs.question: Where should I check a campus schedule or a weather-related change?
faqs.answer: Use the ACPS School Hours page for the district’s dismissal schedules, and check your child’s school and district announcements for changes. A campus bell schedule and an emergency make-up notice can affect plans beyond the dates in the annual PDF.

editorialSummary.heading: School Breaks, UF Homecoming and Flex Days
paragraphs: Thanksgiving week, November 23–27, 2026, has no student classes. The district lists November 23–24 as a Student/Teacher Holiday and November 25–27 as the Thanksgiving holiday. October 9 for UF Homecoming and October 16 for a teacher workday are two separate Fridays off, not a continuous fall break.

Winter holiday runs from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. The district also lists December 18 and January 4 as Flex Days—student/teacher holidays that can become make-up school days after a hurricane or another emergency closure. December 18 would be used first. If neither Flex Day is needed, students finish classes December 17 and return January 5. The second semester starts January 12, a week after the planned return.

Spring break is March 15–19, 2027, with classes scheduled to resume March 22. March 26 marks the end of the third nine weeks, not a student holiday. Students have March 29 off for a teacher workday. Report cards and interim reports have separate release dates in Family Access.

Wednesday early-release schedules are published separately from the annual student calendar. Families should use the ACPS School Hours page and their campus bell schedule for dismissal times, pickup and transportation arrangements.
highlights: Flex Days: December 18, then January 4 if needed

statistics.label: Student attendance days
statistics.explanation: Calculated from 210 weekdays between the first and last student days, adjusting for 28 confirmed no-school weekdays, 2 conditional make-up weekdays currently listed without regular classes. The scheduled attendance dates may change if the district activates a make-up day.

statistics.label: Confirmed non-conditional no-school weekdays
statistics.explanation: Counted from confirmed no-class events between the first and last student days. Conditional make-up dates are excluded because they may become attendance days.

statistics.label: Student holidays for teacher workdays
statistics.explanation: Counts October 16, January 15 and March 29, when the calendar lists no student classes for teacher workdays. Named holidays, multi-day breaks and the two conditional Flex Days are excluded.

statistics.label: Longest break excluding Flex Days
statistics.explanation: December 19, 2026–January 3, 2027, including weekends. This excludes the conditional Flex Days on December 18 and January 4. If both remain holidays, the scheduled no-class stretch extends to 18 consecutive calendar days, December 18–January 4.

statistics.label: Long weekends
statistics.explanation: Counts three- or four-day no-school stretches formed by a weekend plus one or two confirmed weekday closures. Longer school breaks are excluded.

statistics.label: Full-week breaks
statistics.explanation: Counts continuous no-school stretches containing at least five confirmed weekdays without regular classes. Adjacent holidays and weekends remain part of the same break.

about.dataSource: Dates come from ACPS’s 2026-27 10-Month School Calendar, marked Updated: 1/27/26. The PDF supplied locally matches the file returned by the district’s short link. The district’s Events and School Hours pages provide the update and dismissal-schedule references.
about.processing: The two November holiday entries remain separate events; their combined five-day span is shown as a planning summary. Winter and spring retain the published ranges, with Flex Days outside confirmed closure totals. The planned 180 attendance days come from 210 weekdays minus 28 confirmed closures and two Flex Days. The four printed 45-day figures add to the same annual total, but the dated periods calculate to 45, 45, 46 and 44 days. Period-end dates are preserved; separate period totals are not published. Staff pre-planning, post-planning and Memorial Day after the last student day are omitted. The PDF does not supply recurring early-release dates or clock times. The alternate official PDF indexed at the c3763616 URL adds (Tentative) to the October 9 UF Homecoming label, while the original local/hash-matched PDF omits it. The alternate PDF's Tentative wording is retained in sourceDiscrepancies. An October 5 ACPS school notice confirms October 9 as a no-class day, so the event display name no longer carries the tentative qualifier. No PDF revision order is inferred.
about.updates: The PDF and official website were checked October 15, 2026. January 27 is the update date printed on the PDF, not a separately verified Board approval date. Check ACPS announcements after an emergency closure before treating December 18 or January 4 as a day off. On October 19, the user-supplied alternate PDF was read through the web index; its direct download returned AccessDenied, so no replacement content hash or current-byte comparison is claimed. School Hours indexed content and official Family Access support notices were reviewed for the two added FAQs. The original short link was also downloaded successfully and still matches the stored af72602f hash, without the Tentative qualifier. These targeted checks do not replace the October 15 verification date of the original annual source. On October 20, the full Newberry High School October 5 announcement was read and confirmed no school on October 9. This corroborates the published no-class date without establishing which of the two January 27 PDF versions came later.
about.disclaimer: Confirm weather changes and campus dismissal times with ACPS or your child’s school. December 18 and January 4 may become make-up school days, and the planned January return can change.

faqs.question: When does school start in Alachua County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day for students is Monday, August 10, 2026. August 3-7 is staff pre-planning, so those dates are not the start of classes for students.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school in Alachua County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Friday, May 28, 2027. The 10-month calendar does not label it a half day or give a dismissal time. Check your school for any end-of-year schedule announcements.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes November 23-27, 2026, and are scheduled to return Monday, November 30. The PDF lists November 23-24 as a Student/Teacher Holiday and November 25-27 as the Thanksgiving holiday. Those back-to-back entries give students the full week off.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Alachua County schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district's winter holiday runs from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. December 18 and January 4 are separate Flex Days currently scheduled as student/teacher holidays. Unless a Flex Day is used to make up an emergency closure, the last day of classes before the break is December 17, and students return January 5. Check ACPS announcements for changes.

faqs.question: When do Alachua County students go back to school after winter break?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled to return on Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a Flex Day currently listed as a student/teacher holiday, but it may become a make-up school day after an emergency closure. January 12 is the start of the second semester, not the scheduled return from winter break.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Alachua County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs from Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students are scheduled to return Monday, March 22. Monday, March 29 is a separate student holiday for a teacher workday, not an extension of spring break.

faqs.question: Do Alachua County students have school on UF Homecoming?
faqs.answer: No. Students had no school on Friday, October 9, 2026, for UF Homecoming. Although one version of the district calendar marked the date tentative, Newberry High School confirmed the closure in an October 5 notice. It was a single-day holiday, not a week-long fall break.

faqs.question: Is there a fall break in Alachua County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 calendar does not list a separate week-long October fall break. Students had October 9 off for UF Homecoming and October 16 off for a teacher workday, with regular school days between them. Students also have the full Thanksgiving week off, November 23–27.

faqs.question: Do students have school on teacher workdays in Alachua County?
faqs.answer: No classes are scheduled for students on October 16, 2026, January 15, 2027, or March 29, 2027. These dates are listed as student holidays and teacher workdays. January 15 falls on a Friday, followed by Martin Luther King Jr. Day on Monday, January 18, giving students four consecutive days off.

faqs.question: Which other public holidays are days off during the school year?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists Labor Day on September 7, 2026; Veterans Day on November 11, 2026; Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, 2027; and Presidents Day on February 15, 2027. These are in addition to UF Homecoming and the longer holiday breaks.

faqs.question: What are Flex Days, and could students have to attend school on them?
faqs.answer: December 18, 2026, and January 4, 2027, are currently student/teacher holidays reserved for making up hurricane or other emergency closures. The district says it will use December 18 first, then January 4. If closures exceed the available Flex Days, it may add minutes to the school day after using those dates. A Flex Day is not a guaranteed day off.

faqs.question: When does the second semester begin?
faqs.answer: The second semester begins Tuesday, January 12, 2027. That is not the planned return from winter break: students are scheduled to return January 5 unless January 4 is activated as a make-up day.

faqs.question: When do the nine-week grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The first three nine-week periods end October 13, 2026, January 11, 2027, and March 26, 2027. The final student day is May 28. A grading period ending does not by itself mean students have the day off; the separate student holidays are listed elsewhere in the calendar.

faqs.question: When will report cards be available in Family Access?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists report cards in Family Access on October 22, 2026, January 21, 2027, and April 6, 2027. It does not give a final report-card release date. May 28 is the last student day, not a separately announced final report-card date.

faqs.question: When are interim progress reports available?
faqs.answer: Interim reports are listed for September 15 and November 19, 2026, and February 18 and May 4, 2027. These are progress updates during a grading period, separate from the report-card release dates.

faqs.question: Do Alachua County schools have early release on Wednesdays?
faqs.answer: Yes, but the schedule is not the same for every school. For 2026-2027, ACPS lists weekly Wednesday early release for all elementary schools, High Springs Community School, A. Quinn Jones Center, Sidney Lanier Center, and Duval Early Learning Academy. Check the district's School Hours page or your child's school for the applicable dismissal time. The 10-month student calendar does not list individual early release times.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Alachua County school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: The official ACPS 2026-27 10-Month School Calendar PDF is linked from this page. The document is marked Updated: 1/27/26. Check the district's Events page and school announcements for later schedule changes.

faqs.question: Where can I find school start and dismissal times for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Start and dismissal times vary by campus. The district's 2026-27 School Hours page lists individual school schedules, including Wednesday early-release times. The annual 10-month calendar does not provide a single district-wide bell schedule. Check your child's school for changes.

faqs.question: How can I view my child's report card in Skyward Family Access?
faqs.answer: ACPS makes report cards available through Skyward Family Access. Instructions are available at alachuaschools.net/progressreports, and account setup information is at alachuaschools.net/familyaccess. The school calendar lists report-card release dates but does not specify an exact posting time.

sourceDiscrepancies.effect: The PDF prints 45 days for each of the first three nine-week periods and 45 beside May 28. Using its stated period-end dates, weekday dates and holidays, while leaving both Flex Days as holidays, gives 45, 45, 46 and 44 attendance dates. Both methods sum to 180 for the year. Preserve the official period-end dates and omit per-period attendance totals; do not invent a closure or move a boundary to force 45 days.

The hash-matched district PDF labels October 9 as Holiday - UF Homecoming, while an alternate indexed district PDF adds (Tentative). Both display Updated: 1/27/26, so their revision order remains unknown. A Newberry High School announcement dated October 5, 2026 confirms no classes on October 9. The event display name follows the confirmed school status, while the differing PDF labels remain documented. Attendance-day counts are unchanged.
